capabilities: parse Dataview-style inline fields from Markdown transaction logs
summarize monthly income, expenses, transfers, and recent records
rank categories and show member distribution
configure the transaction folder, month, and confidence threshold
disambiguation: Not a transaction-entry tool; it only reads existing Markdown transaction logs and displays a dashboard, it does not create records.
extras: README includes a Chinese-language section and the dashboard's default title is Chinese (甜菜自动化记账). It stresses offline behavior: no network access, uploads, or telemetry.
motivation: It was built for shortcut-driven bookkeeping workflows: append one Markdown line per transaction, then open the dashboard to review the results.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn plain transaction lines in notes into an overview of income, expenses, and categories.

relations.evidence: Auto Ledger reads Dataview-style inline fields.

summary: Finance dashboard that reads local Markdown transaction logs and summarizes monthly income, expenses, categories, members, and records needing review.
